translations.literal: Bandits robbed Zhang Ju of Jixian County of twelve hundred ingots of notes and killed him; the bandits were not captured; Bingzhi prepared a text and prayed at the City God shrine, and sent men to watch at the place of death; suddenly a villager named Alian, trembling in fear, fell to the ground and fully stated the bandits' names and whereabouts; he then ordered the constable to raid them and truly obtained the bandits at Bian; he then rectified their crime.
translations.idiomatic: Bandits robbed and murdered Zhang Ju of Jixian for twelve hundred ingots of paper money and escaped; Bingzhi prayed at the City God shrine and posted men at the murder site; a villager named Alian, shaking with fear, collapsed and named the culprits; Bingzhi sent constables who captured them at Bian and brought them to justice.

sentences.zh: 秋七月，蟲螟生，民患之，秉直禱於八蜡祠，蟲皆自死。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of autumn locusts and borers arose; the people suffered from them; Bingzhi prayed at the shrine of the Eight La, and the insects all died of themselves.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month locusts and caterpillars plagued the crops; Bingzhi prayed at the shrine of the Eight La, and the pests died away.

sentences.zh: 歲大饑，人相食，死者過半，秉直出俸米，倡富民分粟，餒者食之，病者與藥，死者與棺以葬。

translations.literal: The year had great famine; people ate one another; the dead exceeded half; Bingzhi issued his salary grain, urged wealthy households to divide grain, gave food to the starving, gave medicine to the sick, and gave coffins to bury the dead.
translations.idiomatic: Famine struck so hard that people ate the dead and more than half perished; Bingzhi gave his salary grain, urged the wealthy to share their stores, fed the hungry, tended the sick, and buried the dead in coffins he provided.

sentences.zh: 天不雨，禾且槁，秉直詣城北太行之蒼峪神祠，具詞祈祝，有青蛇蜿蜒而出，觀者異之。

translations.literal: Heaven did not rain; the grain was about to wither; Bingzhi went to the shrine of the Cangyu god on Mount Taihang north of the city, prepared a text and prayed; a green serpent wound out; onlookers marveled.
translations.idiomatic: When drought withered the crops, Bingzhi prayed at the Cangyu shrine on Mount Taihang north of the city; a green serpent emerged, to the wonder of all who saw it.

sentences.zh: 辭神而還，行及數里，雷雨大至。

translations.literal: He took leave of the god and returned; he had gone several li when great thunder and rain arrived.
translations.idiomatic: He left the shrine and had gone only a few li when a thunderstorm broke.

sentences.zh: 秩滿，以親老，去官侍養。

translations.literal: When his term was complete, because his parents were old, he left office to serve and support them.
translations.idiomatic: When his term ended he resigned to care for his aged parents.

sentences.zh: 許義夫，碭山人。

translations.literal: Xu Yifu, a man of Dangshan.
translations.idiomatic: Xu Yifu came from Dangshan.

sentences.zh: 為夏邑縣尹，每親詣鄉社，教民稼穡。

translations.literal: He was magistrate of Xiayi County; each time he personally went to village altars and taught the people sowing and reaping.
translations.idiomatic: As magistrate of Xiayi he personally visited village communities to teach farming.

sentences.zh: 見民勤謹者，出己俸賞之，怠惰者罰之。

translations.literal: When he saw the people diligent and careful he gave rewards from his own salary; the lazy he punished.
translations.idiomatic: He rewarded the diligent from his own salary and punished the idle.

sentences.zh: 三年之間，境內豐足。

translations.literal: Within three years the territory within the borders was abundant and full.
translations.idiomatic: Within three years the district was prosperous.

sentences.zh: 後為封丘縣尹，值至正四年大饑，盜賊群起，抄掠州縣。

translations.literal: Later he was magistrate of Fengqiu County; it happened to be the great famine of the fourth year of Zhizheng; bandits rose in groups and plundered prefectures and counties.
translations.idiomatic: Later, as magistrate of Fengqiu during the great famine of 1344, bandits rose everywhere and raided the prefectures.

sentences.zh: 義夫聞賊至近境，乃單馬出郊十里外迎之，見賊數百人，義夫力言：「封丘縣小民貧，皆已驚惶逃竄，幸無入吾境也。

translations.literal: Yifu heard the bandits had reached the near border; he then went alone on horseback ten li beyond the suburbs to meet them; he saw several hundred bandits; Yifu spoke forcefully: "Fengqiu County is small and the people poor; all are already frightened and fleeing—may you fortunately not enter our border."
translations.idiomatic: Hearing bandits were near, Yifu rode out alone ten li beyond the town to meet several hundred of them and pleaded, "Fengqiu is small and poor; the people have already fled in terror—please do not enter our district."

sentences.zh: 」言辭願款，賊遂他往。

translations.literal: " His words were earnest and sincere; the bandits then went elsewhere.
translations.idiomatic: " His words were so earnest that the bandits turned away.

sentences.zh: 封丘之民，得免於難。

translations.literal: The people of Fengqiu were able to escape calamity.
translations.idiomatic: The people of Fengqiu were spared the disaster.
